author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin McGonigle goes deep in win over Yankees
desc: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-5 in a win over the Yankees with a solo home run and two runs scored.
impact: McGonigle continues an impactful stretch of late, getting on base in 17 of his last 18 contests. The rookie continues to reward manager AJ Hinch as one of the few dynamic options in an inconsistent Tigers lineup, carrying an .815 OPS with seven home runs, 31 RBI, 54 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 84 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin Harris opts out of minor league deal with White Sox
desc: Dustin Harris opted out of his minor-league contract with the Chicago White Sox.
impact: Harris was hitting .312 with an .886 OPS with Triple-A Charlotte. He is now a free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hurston Waldrep to throw 75-80 pitches Thursday
desc: Braves manager Walt Weiss said they're hoping to get 75-80 pitches out of Hurston Waldrep on Thursday.
impact: Waldrep is taking the mound against the Cardinals. He'll likely look to at least go five frames for Atlanta.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mookie Betts (wrist) back in lineup Thursday
desc: Mookie Betts is back in the Dodgers lineup on Thursday against the Padres.
impact: Betts was previously scratched from the Dodgers lineup. He is back at shortstop and batting cleanup.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby to start Sunday
desc: George Kirby will start Sunday's series finale against the Blue Jays.
impact: Kirby will draw a normal start after Logan Gilbert and Emerson Hancock piggyback on Saturday. He allowed two runs over eight innings in his last start against the Angels.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock to pitch in piggyback role Saturday
desc: Emerson Hancock will pitch in a piggyback role behind Logan Gilbert on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Gilbert will figure to pitch the first half of the game roughly. Hancock will enter the game behind him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Gilbert to start Saturday ahead of Emerson Hancock in piggyback role
desc: Logan Gilbert and Emerson Hancock are expected to piggyback on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Gilbert will figure to pitch the first half of the game, give or take before Hancock enters the game. It will limit their upside for fantasy managers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Castillo to start Friday
desc: Luis Castillo will start on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Castillo will draw a normal start to open Friday's series. He is coming off allowing one run over six innings against the Guardians in his last start.

author: Ari Koslow
title: German Marquez (forearm) activated from IL
desc: The Padres activated German Marquez from the injured list.
impact: Marquez works his way back from forearm nerve inflammation. Jason Adam (shoulder) was placed on the injured list as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jason Adam (shoulder) placed on IL
desc: The Padres placed Jason Adam on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Adam is dealing with a right shoulder strain. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Austin Voth signs minor league deal with Rangers
desc: The Rangers signed Austin Voth to a minor league contract.
impact: Voth was previously with the Twins. He'll add pitching depth in the Rangers organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin May (back) to start Thursday
desc: Dustin May is back on the mound on Thursday against the Braves.
impact: May had his last start skipped because of lingering back pain. He makes his return on Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Miles Mikolas suspended five games
desc: The MLB has suspended Miles Mikolas five games.
impact: Mikolas gets handed a suspension for his involvement in this week's incident between Willson Contreras and Cade Cavalli. It is unclear if he will appeal the suspension.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Cavalli given seven-game suspension
desc: The MLB has suspended Cade Cavalli seven games.
impact: Cavalli and Willson Contreras each got seven-game suspensions following an incident earlier this week. It is unclear if either of them will appeal their suspensions.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nate Eaton suspended three games
desc: The MLB has suspended Nate Eaton three games.
impact: Eaton gets suspended following his involvement in the incident between Willson Contreras and Cade Cavalli. It is unclear if he will appeal the suspension.
